FZUS53 KDLH 232318
NSHDLH

Nearshore Marine Forecast
National Weather Service Duluth MN
617 PM CDT Fri Oct 23 2026

For waters within five nautical miles of shore on Lake Superior.         

Waves are the significant wave height - the average of the highest 
1/3 of the wave spectrum. Occasional wave height is the average of 
the highest 1/10 of the wave spectrum.

Grand Portage to Grand Marais MN-
617 PM CDT Fri Oct 23 2026

...DENSE FOG ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 1 AM CDT SATURDAY...

.REST OF TONIGHT...East wind 5 to 10 knots becoming southeast
10 to 15 knots with gusts to around 20 knots after midnight.
Patchy dense fog until early morning. Chance of rain showers
after midnight. Slight chance of rain showers toward daybreak.
Waves 1 to 3 feet. 
.SATURDAY...South wind 15 to 20 knots with gusts to around
25 knots becoming southwest 10 to 15 knots with gusts to around
25 knots in the afternoon. Chance of rain showers in the
afternoon. Waves 2 to 4 feet. A small craft advisory may be
needed. 
.SATURDAY NIGHT...West wind 10 to 15 knots. Gusts up to 20 knots
in the evening. Chance of rain showers in the evening. Waves 2 to
4 feet subsiding to 1 to 2 feet after midnight. 
.SUNDAY...West wind 10 to 15 knots. Gusts up to 20 knots in the
afternoon. Mostly sunny. Waves 1 to 2 feet.
